meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启动网文创作工作台，集中管理拆文、写作与编辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在写网络小说，需要一个统一入口管理拆文、项目与编辑。
copy.tagline_en: Launch a web novel writing workspace to manage story breakdowns and projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want a single hub for story libraries and editing.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出写小说、拆文、扫榜等模糊请求时,它会先判断你的意图,再自动转给对应的子技能处理;还可以帮你查看项目里在写哪几本书、切换当前书,以及检查工具箱有没有新版本。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story”“$story”“/网文”等触发词,或说“我想写小说”“帮我写书”“检查更新”等请求时触发;请求不明确时它会先问你。

say.note: 它会询问你想写长篇还是短篇,再转给对应写作技能。
它会对比当前版本和最新版本,并询问是否更新。
它会列出项目里在写的书,让你选择切到哪一本。

howto.what_en: When you make vague requests about writing novels, analyzing chapters, or scanning rankings, it identifies your intent and routes to the corresponding sub-skill. It can also list your current books, switch the active book, and check for toolbox updates.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "/story", "$story", "/网文", or phrasings such as "I want to write a novel", "help me write a book", or "check for updates". If unclear, it asks.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel.
say_en.note: It asks whether you want a long or short story, then routes accordingly.
It compares current vs latest version and asks if you want to update.
It lists your in-progress books and lets you pick one.
